caption: Choose old and new Atlas lockfiles in the vault.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['lockfile-upgrade-notes']; window.__lunModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const m=p.openCompare('Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json'); window.__lunModal=m; return 'ok';})()

caption: Compare the Atlas package versions with numeric labels.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['lockfile-upgrade-notes']; window.__lunModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const m=p.openCompare('Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json'); window.__lunModal=m; await m.previewFiles(); if(m.preview.comparison.rows.length!==10) throw new Error('Wrong sample');return 'ok';})()

caption: Keep nested installations and incomplete entries as separate rows.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['lockfile-upgrade-notes']; window.__lunModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); const m=p.openCompare('Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json'); window.__lunModal=m; await m.previewFiles(); const w=m.contentEl.querySelector('.lun-table-wrap'); w.scrollTop=w.scrollHeight;return 'ok';})()

caption: Open the saved Atlas report with both source links.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['lockfile-upgrade-notes']; window.__lunModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); app.vault.setConfig('readableLineLength',false); p.settings.reportName='Atlas upgrade review'; const f=await p.createReport(await p.compare('Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json')); await p.openReport(f); await app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().setViewState({type:'markdown',state:{file:f.path,mode:'preview'}});return 'ok';})()

caption: Save a named Atlas file pair with Pro.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['lockfile-upgrade-notes']; window.__lunModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('lockfile-upgrade-notes-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.savePair('Atlas dashboard','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json'); const m=p.openCompare('Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json'); window.__lunModal=m; m.pairName='Atlas dashboard'; m.project='Atlas dashboard'; m.render(); m.contentEl.scrollTop=m.contentEl.scrollHeight;return 'ok';})()

caption: Compare the new file with a local Atlas baseline with Pro.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['lockfile-upgrade-notes']; window.__lunModal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http=async()=>({status:200,json:{data:{viewer:{login:'demo-reader'},user:{sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor:{isActive:true,isOneTimePayment:false,tier:{name:'$5 a month',monthlyPriceInCents:500}}}}}}); app.secretStorage.setSecret('lockfile-upgrade-notes-github-token','gho_'+'0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.saveBaseline('Atlas dashboard','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json'); const m=p.openCompare('Lockfile Upgrade Notes/Old/package-lock.json','Lockfile Upgrade Notes/New/package-lock.json'); window.__lunModal=m; m.baselineName='Atlas dashboard'; m.project='Atlas dashboard'; m.preview=await p.compareBaseline('Atlas dashboard',m.newPath); m.render(); m.contentEl.querySelector('.lun-summary').scrollIntoView({block:'start'});return 'ok';})()
